blocks.text: 🪝 MHA Launches 'VINIMAY' Land Port Management System for 15 Operational Land Ports. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Digitises 90% paperwork using Single Electronic Window and ANPR gate systems.
VINIMAY Platform: Integrated digital platform launched by Amit Shah under MHA's 'Smart Borders' strategy.
Efficiency Gain: Cuts truck waiting times by 40-60% and gate processing by 22-35%.
Trade Growth: Land port trade surged 16-fold from ₹5,000 crore in 2014 to ₹83,000 crore in 2026.
Operational land ports in India (15) vs total proposed border land ports (74).
